title: Sheldrake's TED Talk censored and taken off YouTube
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sheldrake's TED Talk censored and taken off YouTube, about 2013 at TED / YouTube, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in 2013 rert sheldrick's Ted Talk was censored and taken off YouTube

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2013 a talk given by the scientist Rupert Sheldrake for TED, a well-known series of short public lectures, was censored and taken off YouTube. He tells it to suggest that mainstream science pushes out ideas it finds uncomfortable.
